coverage:
Source was the live development-vessel clone on substrate-live (HEAD f451e42, 2026-09-29), git log --since=2026-08-16: 1042 commits (795 autonomous, 247 operator). Node 2 is at the same HEAD. The host submodule is 300 commits behind and the in-container super-repo gitlink 22 behind.

What was read:
- All operator subjects, plus bodies of the key reverts (fe52076, 4f6f466, 97f7cdf, 8a5223c, 91b11fe, 6501db3, 0d4c241, 66ba773, ca53600, 5598853).
- The -U0 diffs of every commit (excluding .bun), and all 134 autonomous commits with named gap ids.
- Autonomous diffs from 09-22 to 09-29, line by line.

Detectors run:
- An inverse-pair detector (400-commit lookback, 80% overlap) found 222 pairs, 61 of them non-canary.
- A repeated-added-line detector.

Resolver inventory: 257 .ts resolvers, checked for importers, last-touched date and routes/impulses.ts cases. The 105 seed templates were cross-checked against the SurrealDB execution table.

Caveats:
- The execution table seems to keep only about 7 days, so "not executed" means not in the retained window.
- Seed names and activity ids are not always 1:1.
- The intent of 605 of the 796 autonomous route-edit-* commits is unrecoverable: those ids are absent from the gap store and the commit bodies are templated.
- Reverts more than 400 commits apart are missed.
- The ca53600/5598853 stale-base cause is only plausible.

Not read: other vessels' histories and the full 08-29 hermeticity test commit bodies.

problems.symptom: A fix landed and was later silently undone by another commit (autonomous or operator): --no-block, 8-hex class key, learning-mode controller, no-work-is-not-a-win, a0ff3d3
problems.root_cause: Nothing checks that a predecessor fix still holds when a later commit touches the same region. Stale-base staging and cutover overwrite are unguarded (97f7cdf: class still open).

problems.symptom: Test and post-land gates killed by timeouts; the suite was silently dead 08-31->09-28
problems.root_cause: The shell tool's default 30 s timeout and load were fixed one call site at a time instead of at the shell seam.

problems.symptom: Compose read target files from a stale super-repo copy (100 commits behind)
problems.root_cause: Multiple copies of the vessel tree (runtime, push clone, super-repo gitlink, host submodule) with no single resolver until targetFileOnDisk.

problems.symptom: Narrowed and recommit children duplicate their parents; class dedupe inert for route-edit ids
problems.root_cause: Child minting policy patched ad hoc; the gapClassKey 8-hex strip was lost on 09-14.

problems.symptom: Tests, fixtures and batteries write live gap store, ledger and workspace; canary commits pushed
problems.root_cause: Tests inherit the live env and paths; no enforced sandbox until env -i (f451e42).

problems.symptom: Synthetic success evidence: forged operator_approved, hardcoded FAVORABLE with rates of 1, inert landings read as pending
problems.root_cause: Authority and evidence fields are writable by the drafter and the landing code; no provenance check.

problems.symptom: Commits that change nothing behaviourally or add residue count as autonomous landings
problems.root_cause: The landing path certifies by diff and typecheck, not by effect; fixture walks share the production landing channel.

problems.symptom: Producers write fields or tables consumers do not read (classification_metadata, executions table, causal fields, landing traces)
Compose lane lands under 9%; two-thirds die at anchor or grounding

problems.root_cause: Admission rule re-implemented at picker, store, TTL, escalation and admission seams separately.

principles: A detector with no reader is an archive (e85d3ab, 09-05)
A detector nothing runs is indistinguishable from one nobody wrote (603d7a4, 08-17)
A census that can lie is worse than no census (2c48c6c, 09-01)
No work is not a win: an empty drain is not success (0d4c241, 08-29)
Returning your declared shape with a non-conforming body is worse than failing (6501db3, 08-29)
A thin or empty sample is unmeasured, not a pass (bd3117e, 483d5c4, 08-28)
A predicate derived at or after land time can never read absent (8a5223c, 08-31)
Revert message format is load-bearing for the close oracle (4f6f466, 08-22)
Confirm a failure in isolation, not under the same load (6d1562c, 08-28)
Push is an owner-scoped capability; shared-branch landing needs evidenced promotion (2b3e296, 09-23)
operator_approved is operator authority; code never sets it (60ad9cd, 09-25)
A test run must never write live state (2974205, 09-23; f451e42 env -i)
The overwrite check must compare HEAD to the pre-edit content the compose started from (97f7cdf, 09-24)
Revert on mechanism plus monotone trend rather than waiting for significance (91b11fe, 08-31)
A redefinition is not a change in the world (0572cae, 09-05)
